name: Exp_JBrainTrend1Stop_ReOpen
summary: This EA implements the JBrainTrend1 trend-following strategy with a stop-and-reopen mechanism. It enters positions based on the JBrainTrend1 indicator signals and closes/reverses when the trend direction changes, reopening positions in the new trend direction. The 'Stop_ReOpen' logic allows it to exit a trade on a trend reversal signal and immediately re-enter in the opposite direction.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了JBrainTrend1趋势跟踪策略，并带有停止重开机制。它根据JBrainTrend1指标信号入场，在趋势方向改变时平仓/反转，并立即在新趋势方向重新开仓。停止重开逻辑使其能够在趋势反转信号出现时退出当前头寸并立即反向重新进场。
strategy_analysis: JBrainTrend1Stop_ReOpen是一种基于JBrainTrend1指标的趋势跟踪交易系统。入场条件依赖于JBrainTrend1指标的趋势方向判断——当指标发出上升趋势信号时做多，发出下降趋势信号时做空。出场条件同样是基于指标的反转信号，当趋势方向改变时平掉当前头寸。该EA的核心特征是'Stop ReOpen'机制，即在趋势反转时不仅平掉原有头寸，还会立即在反方向重新开仓，从而持续捕捉趋势行情。仓位管理方面，默认使用固定手数交易，用户可通过参数调节。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数设置，但核心的风控仍依赖于指标信号的反转出场。整体策略逻辑清晰，但持续在场的特性意味着在震荡市中可能频繁止损重开，造成连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: JBrainTrend1Stop_ReOpen is a trend-following trading system based on the JBrainTrend1 indicator. Entry conditions rely on the JBrainTrend1 indicator's trend direction assessment — going long when an uptrend signal is detected and going short when a downtrend signal appears. Exit conditions are also based on the indicator's reversal signals, closing the current position when the trend direction changes. The core feature of this EA is the 'Stop ReOpen' mechanism, which not only closes the existing position on a trend reversal but immediately reopens in the opposite direction, continuously capturing trending markets. Position sizing uses fixed lot trading by default, adjustable via user parameters. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameter settings, but the core risk control still relies on the indicator's reversal signal for exits. The overall strategy logic is clear, but the always-in-market characteristic means that in choppy/ranging markets it may frequently stop and reopen, causing consecutive losses.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss amount, 0 disables overall stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Hedge pair net profit target in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔数标识，用于区分不同EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: ReOpen
parameters.description: 是否在平仓后立即反向重新开仓
parameters.description_en: Re-open reverse position immediately after close

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于单一指标的趋势跟踪易于理解和验证
Stop ReOpen机制确保持续捕捉趋势行情，不会错过大级别趋势
参数较少，用户调优空间明确，降低了过度拟合的风险
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on a single indicator, making trend following easy to understand and verify
The Stop ReOpen mechanism ensures continuous capture of trending markets without missing major trends
Few parameters with clear tuning scope, reducing the risk of overfitting
cons: 在震荡行情中会频繁反转开仓，产生大量无效交易和滑点成本
默认止损和止盈为0，完全依赖指标反转信号出场，缺乏价格层面的硬性风控
固定手数交易缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户资金和波动率自适应调整
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线内重复交易
cons_en: Frequent reversals in choppy/ranging markets generate numerous ineffective trades and slippage costs
Default stop loss and take profit are zero, relying entirely on indicator reversal signals without hard price-level risk control
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adapt to account equity and volatility changes
No new bar check mechanism, potentially leading to repeated trades within the same bar
improvements: 增加震荡市过滤机制（如ADX或ATR阈值），在低趋势强度时暂停交易以减少无效反转
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理，使风控参数随市场波动率自适应调整
添加新K线检查逻辑，避免在同一根K线内多次开平仓
improvements_en: Add a choppy market filter (such as ADX or ATR threshold) to pause trading during low trend strength and reduce ineffective reversals
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit and position sizing to adapt risk parameters to market volatility
Add a new bar check logic to prevent multiple open/close operations within the same bar

risk_points: 默认止损为0，在极端行情中可能遭受远超预期的单笔亏损
持续在场机制在震荡市中会产生连续亏损，缺乏最大连续亏损限制
缺少新K线检查，可能在快速波动中重复下单
risk_points_en: Default stop loss of zero may result in unexpectedly large single-trade losses during extreme market moves
Always-in-market mechanism can produce consecutive losses in ranging markets without a maximum drawdown limit
Lack of new bar checking may cause duplicate orders during rapid price fluctuations
